findings.current: The jerky you stuffed into your mouth barely fifteen minutes ago would’ve been enough for a whole calf.
findings.defect: Changes the amount of jerky Taishan ate into an amount sufficient to feed a calf.
findings.rationale: Namho says the jerky Taishan ate alone amounted to an entire calf.
findings.replacement: The jerky you stuffed into your mouth barely fifteen minutes ago amounted to a whole calf.
findings.source: 고작 일각 전에 네놈 주둥이로 들어간 육포만 따져도 송아지 한 마린데.

findings.current: “Damn it. I’ll give you another once we’re on our way.”
findings.defect: Moves the promised second sweet from their return to their departure.
findings.rationale: 돌아가는 대로 means upon returning, not once they set off.
findings.replacement: “Damn it. I’ll give you another as soon as we get back.”
findings.source: 빌어먹을, 돌아가는 대로 하나 더 주마.

findings.current: Otherwise, I’ll personally stick two knives in each of you.
findings.defect: Changes two stabs per person into two knives per person.
findings.rationale: 칼침 두 방씩 counts stab wounds, not weapons.
findings.replacement: Otherwise, I’ll personally stab each of you twice.
findings.source: 그렇지 않으면 제 손으로 직접 칼침 두 방씩 놔 드릴 테니까.

findings.current: Not one of them had enough left to bury.
findings.defect: Adds a claim about the condition of the bodies that the source does not establish.
findings.rationale: 뼈도 못 추리다 conveys being thoroughly beaten or destroyed; it does not say their remains were too scant to bury.
findings.replacement: None of them stood a chance.

summary: Several localized fidelity errors change quantities, a promised reward, and the threatened action.
